errors.text_span: Each model category includes a grouped set of three bars representing different SFT training conditions: "no SFT", "+ SFT on D₀", "+ SFT on D₀, D₁", and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂". The bars within each model category are arranged adjacently, grouped by SFT condition.
errors.evidence: The bars are stacked, not grouped adjacently. The description incorrectly states the structural organization of the chart.

errors.text_span: The "no SFT" bars are colored blue, reaching approximately 65%, 67%, and 71% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: For LLAMA-2-7B, the blue bar reaches approximately 66% (not 65%), and for LLAMA-2-70B, it is just above 80% (not 71%). The 71% value is clearly incorrect based on the image.

errors.text_span: The "+ SFT on D₀" bars are colored orange, reaching approximately 67%, 75% and 75% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: For LLAMA-2-7B, the yellow bar is approximately 66% (not 67%), and for LLAMA-2-13B, it is 72% (not 75%). The 75% value for LLAMA-2-70B is also slightly off (image shows ~81%).

errors.text_span: The "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" bars are colored lavender, reaching approximately 74%, 78% and 79% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively
errors.evidence: For LLAMA-2-7B, the purple bar is around 80% (not 74%), and for LLAMA-2-13B, it is approximately 82% (not 78%). The 79% value for LLAMA-2-70B is also slightly off (image shows ~82%).

errors.text_span: the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" bars are colored pink and reach approximately 76%, 80% and 80% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: For LLAMA-2-7B, the red bar is close to 82% (not 76%), and for LLAMA-2-13B, it is about 80% (correct). The 80% value for LLAMA-2-70B is slightly off (image shows ~80%, but the description omits the nuance of 'close to').

errors.text_span: The "no SFT" bars are colored blue, the "+ SFT on D₀" bars are colored orange, the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" bars are colored lavender, and the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" bars are colored pink
errors.evidence: The colors described as 'orange' and 'lavender' are more accurately described as 'yellow' and 'purple' in the image and atom checklist. While 'orange' and 'lavender' are reasonable synonyms, 'yellow' and 'purple' are more precise.
The description omits the pattern details of the bars (e.g., white diagonal stripes for 'no SFT', white horizontal stripes for '+ SFT on D₀', slanted stripes for '+ SFT on D₀, D₁').

errors.text_span: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between model scale, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset size, and CoLeG-R performance, measured as a percentage.
errors.evidence: The description introduces an interpretive claim ('relationship between model scale, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset size, and CoLeG-R performance') that is not explicitly shown in the figure or supported by the atom checklist.
